study.question: Can task-specific score readouts improve the stronger frozen compressed source when its scorer width, scalar primary initialization and empty-slot Dice population are preserved, and does empty-slot interaction policy explain part of the failed joint implementation?
study.hypothesis: The previous composition changed both scorer capacity and the input population seen by Dice. Empty slots have zero pooled mass but their target-dependent interaction rows affect training normalization of nonempty slots. Retaining the incumbent query interactions may recover predictive quality, after which auxiliary-specific score rows may improve auxiliary representations and shared-context learning without auxiliary gradients entering item/action embeddings or the primary scorer. Useful complementarity requires validation click AUC above both frozen source bests; this is a follow-up implementation, not a novelty claim.

nearest_work.difference: Read archived primary text lines 214-285: inherit unnormalized target-conditioned local activation and Dice. Add fixed uniform/feedback block summaries, task-specific auxiliary affine score rows and source-path gradient protection. These adaptations are already partly present in local sources; no priority claim.

Inspected pinned benchmark forward lines 115-199: task-specific history hubs and repeated token/hub interaction differ from the present single compression/readout stage. No hub aggregation/broadcast is adopted, and this benchmark code is not an audited original-author reproduction.
Registry verifies original-paper link only; detailed primary text unavailable. Original mechanism equivalence and novelty relative to this work remain unverified.
Dice contains BatchNorm1d with momentum 0.01; do not change Dice itself. Factor only the empty interaction rows that enter its existing normalization.

Retain compressed UF routes and task-conditioned affine scoring but restore narrow [64,32] source scorer and source primary/scalar initialization; explicitly cross readout activity with empty-input policy.

inherited_components: g2-r0004-context_only: exact embedding/local_activation/tower construction and reset order, [64,32] scorer, [128,64] towers, ten uniform click slots and twenty feedback-stratified auxiliary slots, count-weighted unnormalized pooling.
g2-r0004-context_only: auxiliary context updates allowed; auxiliary target/history item/action gradients and shared scorer gradients blocked.
g3-r0003-embedding_item_primary and g0-r0006-compressed_task: auxiliary-specific affine score readouts initialized from the primary row; no private trunks.
Frozen host inputs, labels, history policy, scratch recipe, sum of four BCEs and selection scorer. No new data or host changes.
study.proposed_difference: Allocate three auxiliary score rows AFTER the incumbent modules are reset, cloning the primary row inside a CPU RNG-preserving torch.random.fork_rng scope. All four cells allocate these same 99 additional parameters; shared cells leave them inactive. Compute the shared hidden state once and detach it for auxiliary affine readouts; auxiliary values and target are detached during training. Cross routing={task,shared} with empty_slot_inputs={query,zero}, all at [64,32]. Query retains the source target interactions at zero-count slots; zero masks the entire interaction row before Dice. Both keep zero-count slots in the scorer population and give them zero pooling mass. No normalization fix or task-complementarity success is presumed.
predictions: anchor_shared_query should reproduce g2-r0004-context_only primary initialization, persistent scorer buffers, predictions and gradients within declared numerical tolerance; its same-seed training replay is a consistency check only. Exact parity is a prerequisite to treating it as an anchor.

If empty-slot normalization contributes to the previous short-history penalty, query minus zero will improve click AUC especially in pre-existing history_1_16 and history_17_64 slices. Direction is prospective for this new suite; selecting the question from prior slices makes broader mechanism interpretation exploratory.

If task-specific readouts provide useful complementarity, anchored_task_query will exceed anchor_shared_query and both frozen sources (0.660646940486458 and 0.660163362657485) on full-population validation click AUC, followed by paired-seed confirmation where supported.

Task minus shared and query minus zero effects and their difference-in-differences separate readout activity from empty-row population under identical allocated capacity. No direct auxiliary-loss gradient should reach primary scorer or item/action tables; context and the relevant auxiliary row may receive it.
falsifiers: Failure of anchor state/prediction/gradient parity invalidates source-anchored attribution until diagnosed; do not explain it as scientific counterevidence.
No query-versus-zero benefit, or opposite sign, weakens the normalization explanation for this implementation. Slice association alone does not prove a normalization mechanism.
A task-readout candidate failing to exceed the stronger frozen source falsifies useful complementarity for this implementation; auxiliary AUC gains alone do not meet the click-selection objective.

A benefit disappearing across paired seeds or explained by cost/capacity controls remains unsupported. Invalid masking, information use, nonfinite loss or gradient ownership is execution failure, not a mechanism result.
alternative_explanations: Prior compressed-task vs events-task delta is -0.0009691237175439; compressed-shared vs events-shared is -0.0009684766687892. Averaging nonlinear event interactions, width/initialization, padding fraction and Dice statistics may all contribute; the prior factorial does not isolate these.
The previous task-vs-shared click effects are approximately -0.00005254 compressed and -0.00005189 events; near-zero interaction and one seed do not establish task complementarity.
Context updates from auxiliary tasks may alter click indirectly despite protected scorer/item paths. Changing empty slots modifies both batch and running statistics, not observable event values.

Allocated parameters are matched but 99 auxiliary readout parameters are inactive in shared controls; active capacity and extra auxiliary matmul cost differ. The narrow scorer differs from prior wide cells; do not attribute across-width comparisons to a single factor.
Auxiliary mean AUC for strong sources is much lower than baseline (about 0.68 four-task mean versus 0.81); primary selection must not hide this tradeoff or call it joint improvement in every task.
One frozen seed, single pass, offline delayed feedback, whole-window vocabularies and inherited benchmark snapshots limit uncertainty estimates and production validity.

host_prerequisites: Use frozen host readiness/data checks; raw data and training unavailable in coding workspace. Verify full 2871767-row validation with original sample identity; no test feedback.

Confirm all shared embedding/local_activation/tower states initialized identically to g2-r0004-context_only with identical CPU/GPU RNG state after construction; added auxiliary module must not perturb host sampling RNG. Audit embedding aliases before parameter ownership claims.

On identical batches compare anchor_shared_query to source in train and eval: probabilities, loss, all shared gradients and persistent Dice buffers. Declare FP32 tolerance 1e-6 and bf16 tolerance 1e-3; a larger difference blocks replay attribution. Both paths must use the same arithmetic kernels where possible.

Confirm all four cells identical modules/initial weights and initial predictions pairwise within empty-policy groups; auxiliary rows start as copies of the scalar scorer. Perturb each masked raw history field/action/task-mask ID and unknown current action; no prediction change. Empty, sparse and full histories finite; zero-count pooling contribution exactly zero.

For auxiliary-only backward require zero primary scorer/item/action gradients and allowed auxiliary row, tower and context gradients; click-only backward must not update auxiliary readouts. Reconcile aliases and unused gradients explicitly. Persistent scorer Dice buffers updated once per forward.

Report all task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean separately, train/validation/wall/GPU cost, peak memory, allocated/active parameters and inference throughput/p50/p95. Reuse history bins and counts; mark missing field/composition/hour/frequency diagnostics unavailable if not exposed by host; do not fabricate.
